title: Independent reading: Romans 3:21–26
subtitle: Read a compressed theological argument one relation at a time.
overview: Romans 3:21–26 is syntactically dense. Begin by locating the main claim, then map its genitives, prepositions, participles, and purpose clauses in layers.
This lesson trains grammatical restraint: identify possible genitive relationships and let the wider argument guide later interpretation.

items.grc: νυνὶ δὲ χωρὶς νόμου δικαιοσύνη θεοῦ πεφανέρωται.
items.en: But now, apart from law, the righteousness of God has been manifested.

items.grc: δικαιούμενοι δωρεὰν τῇ αὐτοῦ χάριτι διὰ τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
items.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
